home.hero_title: The marketplace for open containers near you
home.hero_subtitle: Groupeurs share the spare space in their containers before departure. ShipRoxy connects you to them like a booking platform.
home.how_it_works_subtitle: Simple by design: tell us your route, we do the matching.
home.step1_desc: Tell us where your package or parcel is starting from and where it needs to go.
home.step2_title: We match you with open containers
home.step2_desc: ShipRoxy searches groupeurs with spare space near your route — if nothing matches exactly, we'll suggest the closest open container.
home.step3_desc: Message the groupeur, agree on price and pickup, and track your shipment to delivery.
home.screenshots_subtitle: A real look at browsing open containers and viewing a full listing.
home.screenshot_browse_caption: Browse open containers with live routes, pricing, and status
home.screenshot_detail_caption: See pickup policy, groupeur ratings, and message them directly
home.features_subtitle: Built for real-world groupage, not just listings.
home.feature_ratings_desc: See a groupeur's rating and past reviews before you ever message them.
home.feature_tracking_desc: Follow your package from received to delivered, with QR code pickup confirmation.
home.feature_pickup_desc: Free pickup, paid pickup, or drop-off only — every listing states its policy upfront.
home.feature_safety_desc: In-app guidance for meeting up safely, plus a quick-start guide you can revisit anytime.
home.feature_teams_desc: Shipping companies can add staff, assign roles, and manage packages together.
home.feature_lang_desc: Available in French, English, Spanish, German, and Swahili.
